title: Singular distributions of random variables with independent digits of representation in numeral system with natural base and redundant alphabet
summary: Given natural parameters s and r, where $2\leq s\leq r$, we consider the distribution of a random variable $ξ=\sum\limits_{k=1}^{\infty}s^{-k}ξ_k\equivΔ^{r_s}_{ξ_1ξ_2...ξ_k...},$ where $(ξ_k)$ is a sequence of independent random variables taking values in $\{0,1,...,r\}$ with probabilities $p_0,p_1,...,p_r$, respectively, and all $ p_i<1$. In the case s=3=r, necessary and sufficient conditions for the singularity and absolute continuity of the distribution of random variable are established.
